messages.subject: First Shiny/Github project
parts:
Hello there!

I have been cobbling together a first shiny/github app and was wondering if it worked on other computers aswell..could you give this a go? I had a shinyIO version too but many plots seem a bit strange (with random white lines appearing in some plots not in others) and generally things are very sluggish. The app itself just has me tinkering with some self-learned-and-probably bogus microeconomics ( if any obvious mistakes draw your attention please tell me about them!) 

Thanks!
T.

To run the app I typed this in rstudio :
runGitHub("playground", "shinyplayground", subdir = NULL,launch.browser=T)
